summary: Post-migration (CRA → Next.js 16 App Router, npm) end-to-end frontend verification against the unchanged FastAPI backend on https://luxury-photo-demo.preview.emergentagent.com. All critical flows pass: Home (hero eyebrow 'Slow · Intimate · Photography', 'Lakshitography' h1, hero-grid with 4 animated tiles, all 5 What-I-Do cards, sections what-i-do/what-i-dont-do/my-approach/final-cta all render with opacity=1 — no hydration-stuck-invisible issue), Navbar client-side routing across nav-home/services/gallery/book/cta-book, Services page with all 5 service-card-<slug> and book-<slug> links routing to /contact?service=<slug>, Contact form prefilled from query param, POST /api/bookings succeeds and booking-success view renders, Gallery filters (All=10, Couples=2, Kids=6) and lightbox open/close, Admin login with seeded admin@lakshitography.com/Lakshita@2025 → dashboard with stats, list, set-status, delete (window.confirm), logout, and /admin guard redirects unauthenticated users to /admin/login. No console errors observed; HMR 502 warnings (noted as harmless) not seen during these runs.
test_report_links: /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (from iteration_1; backend unchanged, not re-executed per request)
action_items: None blocking. Migration to Next.js 16 App Router looks solid. Optional polish (carried over from iter1): consider returning 201 from POST /api/bookings.
critical_code_review_comments: Server Component contact/page.jsx correctly wraps the useSearchParams() ContactForm in <Suspense> — required by Next.js 16 App Router; otherwise build/runtime would error.
AuthContext uses localStorage('lkx_token'); all client components are properly marked 'use client'. SSR-safe: api.js interceptor guards `typeof window !== 'undefined'`.
process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is correctly used in lib/api.js; no hardcoded URLs. NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is set in /app/frontend/.env.

All interactive elements have data-testid attributes as expected by the test plan (hero-grid, hero-tile-{0..3}, service-card-<slug>, book-<slug>, form-name/email/phone/service/submit, gallery-lightbox, lightbox-close, set-status-<value>-<id>, delete-<id>, stat-{total|new|confirmed|completed}, logout-btn).

Admin dashboard `load()` runs in useEffect on user ready; on initial mount stats show 0/0/0/0 briefly until the request completes — this is expected, just call out for next agent to wait ~1.5s before asserting stat values.
HeroGrid timers cleanup uses `clearInterval(id) || clearTimeout(id)` which works but is hacky — minor nit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executed flows (home, nav, services, contact submit, gallery filter+lightbox, admin guard, login, dashboard stats/list, status update, delete, logout)
